model_output.campaign_summary: Grandoreiro, a Delphi-developed banking trojan active since at least 2016, has resurged across Latin America with a strategic focus on Mexico, Spain, and other LATAM countries after relocating from Brazil and Portugal. The campaign targets the financial and banking sector through malicious email attachments disguised as invoices, leveraging DLL side-loading via the legitimate Duplicate Files Finder application combined with sophisticated anti-sandbox/anti-VM evasion techniques to bypass security controls. Active telemetry detections in Colombia confirm active malicious artifacts are currently deployed in the region, representing a high-impact threat to financial institutions across the Americas.
